ruleset.name: SprykerConventions
ruleset.description:
Opinionated Spryker code-convention sniffs (opt-in).
This standard is deliberately NOT part of the default Spryker or SprykerStrict standards, because enabling these conventions would flag pre-existing code across consuming projects. Bumping the package version therefore never activates them on its own - a project opts in explicitly by referencing the SprykerConventions standard (or individual sniffs) from its own ruleset once it is ready to adopt them.
All sniffs in ./Sniffs will be auto loaded.
